description: The built gameplay data of every ability: skill, level, activation type, FP/stamina/item costs, recast group and delay, activation delay, range, targeting and the plain flags that differ from a new AbilityDetail. Delegates are listed by name when set but their bodies are not locked. Animations, visual effects and sounds are in AbilityPresentation.
inputs: 738 abilities sorted by feat id. Activation delay and recast delay are the delegates' results for no activator ("engine" if the delegate needs the engine). settings lists only the fields that differ from the AbilityDetail defaults, as Property=value, sorted by property name.
